references.observed: Downstream photo shows 12 bays, weathered chutes with a common flip lip, flanking solid wings, two lower openings on the right wing, and a continuous catwalk.
Close view shows the separate steel crest deck, tall tapered piers, the radial gate arms, and cross-braced maintenance walk.
River authority lists a 512 m crossing, 275.54 m top, 252.98 m spillway sill, twelve radial gates and 269.75 m full reservoir.
Owner identifies the seven-unit right-bank station and full reservoir level.
The joined native crest road and downstream river establish the signed model frame. The mapped right-bank powerhouse remains separate from the dam face.
